Resolves #19853

The front door has misstated its own size after five of the six edits since the Brain split, because its guard lost its caller: #17806 deleted the `pin-fetch` workflow, and the script survived only in the Brain. This PR returns the guard to neo, beside its `check-*` siblings, restores its path-filtered workflow, and runs `--fix`, which moves the declaration from 55,414 to 56,728 bytes.

Evidence: L2 (the guard's CLI and its spec locally; the restored workflow runs on this PR) → L2 required (the ACs are repository properties). Residual: AC-3 lands with the paired Brain PR.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- |
| AC-1 | At `a424546c48` the guard reports `OK (56,728 bytes / 337 lines / 12 sections, salute + register present)`. On dev `bdaacd9b16` it exits 1 with `declared 55414 bytes, actual 56728`. The spec passes 8/8, including `the LIVE front door passes its own fingerprint check`. |
| AC-2 | `.github/workflows/front-door-fingerprint.yml` runs the guard on PRs and pushes that touch the front door, the guard or the workflow, and this PR touches all three. The seeded-drift control is `checkFingerprint fails on byte/line drift after an edit`. |
| AC-3 | Post-merge: the paired Brain PR. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The spec drops the Brain copy's unused `setup()` and engine imports.
- The script takes neo's `node:` imports and `isEntryModule`.

## Test Evidence
- Local: the spec passes 8/8.
- lint-staged is green: whitespace, JSDoc types, ticket archaeology, block alignment, parse, engine-brain boundary, content-root derivations, fixed sleeps and relative links.
- `check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` reports OK.

## Post-Merge Validation
- The paired Brain PR retires the Brain's copy and its spec (AC-3).
